title: Whole Empty Trough and Cargo Cycle Parking Bay
description: One static public cycle parking and service-equipment bay, one scene and zero new independent models. Three complete qualified originals retain all geometry buffers, normals, opaque PBR, internal hierarchy and original unit scale: an empty lowered-upper-trough two-level rack occupies the left position, a whole low-front-bay cargo bicycle stands independently on its own two tires and deployed feet to the right, and an entire cycle-service post occupies a separate rear position. The rack stays completely empty: the bicycle is not inserted, leaned on it or claimed compatible with either trough. All original empty cargo bay, steering-link exterior, hose and parked nozzle remain untouched. An open foreground joins the separately grounded positions. Unlike the old empty twin-hoop/barrier parking corner or the table-fixture and suspended bicycle repair bay, this shows independent parked cargo transport next to empty two-level parking equipment without a clamp or maintenance workbench. Only whole translations and a finite scene-only paving slab are new. No people, cargo, actual pumping, bicycle fitting, parking operation, security, access compliance, circulation safety, engineering installation or load claim. Rigging animation interaction not made.
